# Intake — UC-001 Invoice triage assistant

## Request summary
Finance Operations wants help routing incoming supplier invoices to the right AP clerk and flagging missing data.

## Problem and pain
Clerks spend 6 minutes per invoice on triage; 8% are misrouted.

## Affected roles
AP clerks, AP supervisors. Staff only.

## Volume
About 1,200 invoices per week, month-end peak 2x.

## Desired outcome
Triage time under 1 minute per invoice, misroutes under 2%.

## Value score
Score: 4/5
High volume and measurable time saving.

## Feasibility score
Score: 4/5
Invoices are already digital; ERP has an API.

## Risk tier rationale
Tier: 2
Protected B supplier data, staff workflow, L1 autonomy.

## Recommendation
Recommendation: go
Clear pain, good data, contained risk.
